perplexity.description:
The Ghostbusters II soundtrack, released in 1989 by MCA Records, is a compilation album featuring a mix of hip hop, rock, and pop tracks tied to the film of the same name. The album is best known for Bobby Brown’s hit single “On Our Own,” which reached number two on the Billboard Hot 100 and became the film’s signature theme. It also includes Run-D.M.C.’s energetic hip hop rendition of Ray Parker Jr.’s original “Ghostbusters,” showcasing the era’s fusion of rap and pop culture. The soundtrack’s blend of contemporary R&B, hip hop, and rock reflects the late 1980s musical landscape and the film’s broad appeal.

As part of the Ghostbusters franchise, the album stands out for its diverse artist roster and its role in bridging the gap between film and mainstream music. While not a traditional artist album, its commercial success was significant, driven by the popularity of Bobby Brown and Run-D.M.C. at the time. The soundtrack received positive attention for its catchy singles and its ability to capture the film’s playful, supernatural tone. Though the original motion picture score by Randy Edelman was not included on the initial release, the album’s pop and hip hop tracks helped solidify its place as a notable soundtrack of the late 1980s.
